Definition: Abijah, the name of several Israelite men and two Israelitesses
BiblicalUsage: Abia or Abiah or Abijah = "Jehovah is (my) father"; 1) king of Judah, son and successor of Rehoboam; 2) second son of Samuel; 3) son of Jeroboam the first, king of Israel; 4) son of Becher, a Benjamite; 5) head of a priestly house (one of the 24 Levite groups); 6) head of a priestly house (after the exile); 7) wife of Hezron; 8) mother of Hezekiah (cf H021)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
